modules.module_title: Plan Equipment Utilization (for operating Bulk Milk Cooler)

pcs.pc_description: ensure working and performance of all machinery required for the process
report malfunctions of the machine, if any, to the supervisor
take the recommended precautions before starting the BMC every day.
calculate the process time for effective utilization of machinery and manpower
assign responsibilities/work to the assistants and helpers

modules.module_title: Organize procured milk and equipment (for operating Bulk Milk Cooler)

pcs.pc_description: illustrate process chart/product flow chart/handling milk
check the quality of procured milk by verifying the quality analysis report from the milk tester and assessing its physical parameters
pre-cool the milk by passing it through the plate cooler/plate heat exchanger by connecting the inlet of the pre-cooler with the outlet of the hauling tank

follow the checklist for proper pre-cooling of the milk - connect the water and milk flow pipes in opposite directions, fit filter on milk line before plate cooler, fit filter on water line if needed.
check regularly whether the inlet and outlet valves are tightly closed and ensuring there is no leakage
connect pipes from the pre-cooler/ dump tank to the inlet of the BMC
start the machine and check the working condition and performance of the machine
practice minor adjustments and repairs (if required)
keep the tools accessible to attend repairs/faults in case of breakdown
keep records of calibrations and observations
ensure that valve of dump tank is open while loading milk in the tanker
follow proper procedure for measurement of milk in the BMC tank using dip stick and conversion table, ensuring that horizontal level of the tank is not disturbed.
ensure that agitator is in ON position when the BMC tank contains milk

pcs.pc_description: inspect the condition of the insulating material between the internal and external cover of the cooling tank
follow SOP to obtain a sample of the milk from the incoming batch of milk
ensure that the temperature of chilling i.e., 4 degrees C has been attained before milk is loaded in a road milk tanker
ensure that there is no over-agitation of milk
monitor the volumetric meter provided on the side of the BMC

modules.module_title: Post operation maintenance of BMC equipment

pcs.pc_description: practice CIP of the tank, pipelines, Pump, filter, etc. as per standard procedure using cleaning agents with the required strength
clean the exterior of the milk cooler using recommended cleaning agents and sanitizers
check the condition of condensing unit regularly
clean the condensing unit regularly and straighten the fins if found dented or pressed against each other
check occasionally that condenser fans are running
check agitator and intermittent agitation
check the tank for excessive buttering and/or foaming
use bright light to check the condition inside the cooling tank
attend minor repairs/faults of all machines (if any)
ensure periodic preventive maintenance (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/annual) of all machines and equipment following the SOP or supplier’s instructions/manuals
ensure that there is free flow of fresh air in the BMC premises so that ambient temperature doe not rise due to stagnant air
